name: Nifty 50 - EMA 105 + confirmations

filters.RSI>50: RSI(14) above 50 for buys / below 50 for sells
filters.MACD hist: MACD(12,26,9) histogram above 0 for buys / below 0 for sells
filters.ADX>25: ADX(14) above 25 - a strong trend exists
filters.Daily>EMA50: yesterday's daily close above daily EMA 50 for buys / below for sells
filters.Daily>EMA200: yesterday's daily close above daily EMA 200 for buys / below for sells
filters.EMA slope: EMA 105 higher than 5 bars ago for buys / lower for sells
filters.0.5 ATR buffer: close at least 0.5 ATR beyond EMA 105
filters.2 closes: two 2-hour closes in a row on the same side
filters.DI+>DI-: DI+ above DI- for buys / DI- above DI+ for sells

exits.cross: only the opposite close through EMA 105
exits.stretch: TOP when the close is k ATR beyond EMA 105
exits.rsi: TOP when RSI(14) reaches the level and then falls 5 points
exits.trail: trailing stop k ATR from the best close
exits.tp: profit target k ATR from entry
exits.bb: TOP when Bollinger %B goes above 1 then back below 0.8

limits: The winner is chosen from 2,000+ tested combinations; even with an unseen out-of-sample third, some luck remains.
2-hour data start Nov 2023 (about 3 years). The out-of-sample third holds only about 10 trades.
Index candles, not futures. Costs 0.035% of price per trade. Gaps between 2-hour bars are included.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
